A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, In-Context Semi-Supervised Learning, with complete main text and Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–37 are identical; page 1 differs only in an author name and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix F report original classification, representation-alignment, transfer, and ablation results on synthetic manifolds, product manifolds, generated images, and ImageNet100.

after.justification: The same original empirical studies and measured outcomes remain in Section 4 and Appendix F, including the appendix ablations and ImageNet100 experiments.

M1.justification: The Laplacian/eigenmap representation module, categorical ICL head, training objectives, and inference procedures are identical in Sections 2–3 and Appendices A–C.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five elementary manifolds, product manifolds, diffusion-generated image manifolds, and ImageNet100 tasks, including the same transfer scenarios.

E2.justification: Eig+ICL, Eig+LR, Orig+RBF-LR, Orig+ICL, and the Transformer baseline retain the same participation in their respective comparisons. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The reported splits, preprocessing, label budgets, model configurations, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures are unchanged throughout Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The depth and kernel comparisons, ID/OOD analyses, image-transfer studies, representation analyses, and Laplacian/eigenvector-module ablations are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Mean and standard-deviation reporting, three-run descriptions, seed information, and the ten-run module ablation in Appendix F.8 are identical.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged, including ImageNet100 alignment in Table 1, ID/OOD and image-transfer results in Tables 2–5, and module ablations in Table 6.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Transformer-construction lemmas and proofs, categorical ICL derivations, and product-manifold distance theorem and proof are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about learning from unlabeled context, spectral representations, label efficiency, and transfer.

C2.justification: Interpretations of representation alignment, the baseline's phase transition, and transfer behavior are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitation concerning small episodic datasets and unavailable established benchmarks.

D1.justification: Implementation details, data-generation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware, computation time, parameter counts, and code-access links are unchanged in Section 7 and the appendices.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to prior ICL and spectral-learning research are identical.

P1.justification: The author line expands 'Michael Li' to 'Zeyu Michael Li'. The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 17 December 2025 to v2 dated 29 January 2026. The prose and document structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–7 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. Pages 2–37 render identically, and the first-page text edits preserve the existing layout.

improvement.justification: The only changes are an expanded author name and updated arXiv stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
